knowledge_gaps: The bound applies to each sampled column, not each unique item: duplicate negatives can accumulate weight. It also does not establish lower false-negative influence than BPR-max. Detached score-dependent allocation defines a training update whose gradients differ from differentiating the displayed weighted loss.

Recency weighting depends on the unspecified window sampler. Per-window normalization can substantially cancel absolute-age effects in older windows; the report needs measured effective target exposure and weight variation before attributing improvements to recent-interest learning.

Reproducibility remains incomplete without the baseline integration, exact comparison order, runtime allocation, checkpoint-selection rule and tie-breaking. Repeated validation selection also risks overfitting the fixed 800-user benchmark.

Originality 4 is plausible for an incremental adaptation; potential 7 remains speculative, and difficulty 4 depends on sampler integration. The report provides no controlled validation evidence establishing superiority over mean pairwise BPR or BPR-max.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify the proposed update's relationship to established methods and whether its claimed robustness follows from bounding sampled-column weights.
